document.name: PlayWell Brooklyn Open-Play
document.shortDescription: PlayWell Brooklyn offers inclusive drop-in open-play in Park Slope, with weekday and weekend sessions in a modular indoor playspace designed for kids of all abilities and ages.
document.longDescription:
PlayWell Brooklyn's official homepage describes the venue as an inclusive indoor playspace for kids of all abilities and ages, offering drop-in open-play, classes, and parties. The site says the space is thoughtfully designed with all kids in mind and describes PlayWell as a place where neurodivergent and neurotypical children and their families can play, build social skills, and work on fitness.

On the membership notes published on the homepage, PlayWell says unlimited open-play is offered Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. and on weekends from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. The same note adds that during after-school hours, Monday through Friday from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., members receive a discounted open-play rate using the code PlayMore. Those published hours support weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon, and after-school availability tags for the open-play listing.

The site's footer lists PlayWell Brooklyn at 94 9th St #218, Brooklyn, NY 11215, with email hello@playwellbrooklyn.com and phone (718) 750-8478. The homepage reviewed did not publish a single standalone drop-in admission price, so ClassScout stores pricing as unknown.

Sources: https://www.playwellbrooklyn.com https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6372ee5f7746cc66b5b44e4e/648744a86d24696a06e0e497_IMG_9996%201.webp
document.announcementDescription: The homepage lists weekday 9 a.m.-4 p.m., weekend 9 a.m.-12 p.m., and weekday after-school 4 p.m.-6 p.m. open-play availability.
